name: Kojou no Kuuron
storyline:
The relationship with my childhood friend changed completely after a certain day.

Having crossed the line, the two of us had lost the words to describe what we were to each other, but starting with a certain incident on July 15th, the gears began to turn with a creaking grind.

Irreversible. Beliefs. Love. A visual novel of wounds and youth, reflected in pathology.
